source_text: Remanete hic cum asino; ego et puer illuc. Servitus et ratio: asinus remanet, mens ascendit.
pass_a_gloss: Remain here with donkey; I and boy there. Servitude and reason: donkey remains, mind ascends.
pass_b_english: [[Stay here with the donkey; I and the boy will go yonder >> Bible:Genesis 22:5]]. Servitude and reason: the donkey stays; the mind ascends.
